name: Healthcare Practice Management: Apply document filing decision
description: Applies the decision on a Document filing form: files the email attachment on the suggested patient or on the Cliniko patient ID entered (with the referrer contact and referral case for a referral), or leaves it unfiled. Comments what was done and closes the item.
